answer.rationale: Renewal best satisfies the primary constraint of not increasing delivery risk: the line has no buffer, the contract expires in 14 days, and prior incumbent renewals avoided migration work and delivery interruption. Although the low-cost vendor meets the spend mandate and previously onboarded quickly, the inherited record does not establish delivery resilience at 94% committed volume. Verify the incumbent-stability evidence before committing; the cost-mandate conflict remains unresolved and should be escalated.
